title: A/R Summary: a payment shows as soon as the report is reloaded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a new customer (created for this test), customer A, with one open invoice, invoice A, of $500.00 on today's date, and nothing else open.
  • Open invoice A's page in a second browser tab, ready to record a payment.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Customer filter showing only customer A ticked.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read customer A's Total and the Totals row.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Record a payment of $200.00 on invoice A.
  4. Switch back to the A/R Summary tab.
  5. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both read $500.00.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A's page shows.

Step 3:

  • The payment is saved and the invoice's balance is $300.00.

Step 4:

  • A/R Summary shows, not yet reloaded.

Step 5:

  • The report reloads, still with only customer A ticked, and customer A's Total and the Totals row both read $300.00 (500.00 − 200.00): the payment shows straight away.

The case reloads the page on purpose: the PRD says going away and back inside the app within 30 seconds, without reloading, can still show the figures from the earlier visit, so only a reload is checked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18b: “The figures are read fresh on every load: reloading the report shows a payment recorded a moment before. Going away and back inside the app within 30 seconds, without reloading, can show the figures from the earlier visit, as on every screen.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
